column2: Score the eggplants lengthwise and soften them in the oven at 200 °C.
Fry the onion, pepper and mince; add the tomato and cook the filling.
Open the eggplants and fill them with the mixture.
Add a little water and bake at 190 °C for about 20 minutes.
İmam bayıldı
2 onions
3 cloves garlic
4 tablespoons olive oil
Bake the eggplants in the oven until soft.
Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil and add the tomato.
Slit the eggplants open and fill with the mixture.
Bake at 180 °C for about 25 minutes and serve lukewarm.
Bulgur pilaf with chickpeas
Soften the onion in a little oil and add the tomato paste.
Wash the bulgur and add it to the pot.
Add the chickpeas and hot water.
Cook over low heat for 15–20 minutes until absorbed, then let rest.
Baked salmon with vegetables
2 salmon fillets
Chop the vegetables finely and spread on a tray.
Place the salmon on top and add oil and lemon.
Bake for about 18–22 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
Chicken and mushroom sauté
350 g boneless chicken
Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Sauté the onion and pepper in a pan; add the chicken.
Once the chicken is fully cooked, add the sliced mushrooms.
Cook until the mushroom liquid evaporates and serve.
Baked köfte with potatoes
Knead the mince, grated onion, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape the köfte and slice the potatoes.
Arrange in a baking dish and add water mixed with tomato paste.
Bake at 200 °C for about 35 minutes until the köfte are fully cooked.
Purslane salad with yogurt
Wash the purslane well and drain.
Add the purslane to the yogurt.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve cold.
Şakşuka (fried vegetables with tomato sauce)
Dice the vegetables and soften them separately in the oven.
Cook the tomato and garlic in a pan until it becomes a sauce.
Mix the vegetables and transfer to a serving plate.
Pour the tomato sauce over the top.
Cheese gözleme
150 g white cheese
Knead a soft dough with flour and water and rest for 10 minutes.
Crumble the cheese and mix with parsley.
Roll the dough thinly, add the filling and close.
Cook both sides in a lightly oiled pan.
Tomato vermicelli soup
Half a cup vermicelli
Grate the tomatoes and cook them in oil for a few minutes.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Add the vermicelli and cook for 10–12 minutes until soft.
Serve hot.
Stuffed zucchini
4 zucchini
150 g minced meat
Hollow out the zucchini.
Mix the rice, mince, finely chopped onion, tomato and tomato paste.
Fill the zucchini loosely with the mixture.
Arrange in a pot, add water to come halfway up; cook for 35–40 minutes.
Baked chicken drumsticks
6 chicken drumsticks
Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the potatoes and carrots into large pieces and toss with the drumsticks.
Add the oil and thyme and spread in a baking dish.
Bake for about 40–45 minutes until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of at least 74 °C.
Rice pilaf with orzo
2 tablespoons orzo
Wash and drain the rice.
Lightly toast the orzo in butter.
Add the rice, stir for 2 minutes and pour in the hot water.
When the water is absorbed over low heat, remove from the heat and rest for 10 minutes.
Baked mücver
100 g white cheese
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the liquid thoroughly.
Mix with the egg, flour, dill and crumbled cheese.
Spread thinly on a tray lined with baking paper.
Bake at 190 °C for 25–30 minutes until cooked through.
Potato oturtma with minced meat
4 potatoes
Slice the potatoes thinly and arrange in a baking dish.
Cook the onion and mince well in a pan.
Add the tomato and tomato paste and simmer for 5 minutes.
Pour the meat sauce over the potatoes, add water and bake at 190 °C for 35 minutes.
Meat and vegetable casserole
400 g diced beef
1 pepper
Sear the meat in a pan.
Chop the vegetables to the same size.
Put the meat and vegetables in the casserole and add oil and half a cup of water.
Bake covered at 180 °C for 65–75 minutes until the meat is tender.
Baked cauliflower with béchamel
Separate the cauliflower into florets and boil for 8 minutes.
Toast the flour in butter and thicken by adding the milk little by little.
Put the cauliflower in a baking dish and pour the sauce over it.
Sprinkle with kashar and brown at 190 °C for 20 minutes.
Red lentil soup
Rinse the lentils; chop the vegetables.
Combine all the ingredients with the water in a pot.
Cook for about 25 minutes until the lentils and vegetables are soft.
Yayla soup
Boil the rice in water until completely soft.
Temper the mixture by adding the hot soup liquid gradually.
Pour the mixture into the pot and bring to a boil while stirring; add mint.
Baked sea bass
2 cleaned sea bass
Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Clean the fish and check for bones.
Place on a tray together with onion and lemon slices.
Drizzle with oil and bake for 25–30 minutes until the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily.
Tuna pasta salad
1 can tuna
Boil the pasta and let it cool.
Dice the cucumber and pepper small.
Combine all the ingredients with the drained tuna.
Add lemon juice and olive oil and serve cold.
Potato salad
3 spring onions
Boil the potatoes in their skins and let them cool.
Peel and dice them.
Finely chop the spring onions and parsley.
Toss with lemon and oil and serve.
Kısır (bulgur salad)
Soak the bulgur in hot water and cover.
Add the tomato paste to the swollen bulgur and mix.
Add the finely chopped greens.
Add lemon juice and serve.
Cheese börek
3 sheets yufka
3 tablespoons vegetable oil
Mix the cheese with parsley.
Whisk the egg, milk and oil.
Layer the yufka in the tray, brushing with the sauce and putting cheese between the layers.
Bake at 180 °C for 30–35 minutes until golden on top and cooked inside.
Vegetable omelette
Half a red pepper
Chop the pepper small and soften it in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and let the liquid evaporate.
Pour the beaten eggs into the pan.
Cook until the eggs are fully cooked.
Artichokes in olive oil
Keep the artichokes in lemon water.
Dice the carrot and potato.
Place the vegetables inside the artichokes and add olive oil and a little water.
Cook covered until the artichokes are soft.
Zucchini boats
Cut the zucchini in half lengthwise and hollow them out.
Fry the onion and mince and add the chopped tomato.
Divide the filling among the zucchini and arrange on a tray.
Soften in the oven at 190 °C with a little water, add kashar and brown.
Smoked eggplant salad
3 eggplants
2 red peppers
Roast the eggplants and peppers and peel them.
Chop the vegetables finely and mix in a bowl.
Add crushed garlic, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve cold or lukewarm.
Green lentil salad
Boil the lentils until soft but not falling apart, and drain.
